title: An Interaction-Aware Decision Framework for FDIC-Assisted Distressed Bank Acquisitions: Empirical Evidence from the FDIC Failed-Bank Panel and the SVB-First Citizens Case
abstract: arXiv:2611.06514v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Acquirers of failed banks weigh acquisition value, regulatory protection, risk, buyer strength, and execution difficulty jointly, because each signal's meaning depends on the others: high non-performing loans matter less when government loss sharing absorbs the losses. The proposed Spider Network Filtering Framework encodes such dependencies as four interpretable interaction rules among five dimensions, yielding graph-inspired features for a logistic model and a Pursue/Caution/Avoid decision rule. We evaluate it on 55 acquisitions assisted by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation in 2008-2024 by acquirers with a parent listed in the United States. Six financial inputs come from regulatory reports published before each failure; two deal terms, which the winning bidder knows when it bids but investors learn at the announcement, come from the regulator's press releases. translated_title: 面向FDIC协助的问题银行收购的交互感知决策框架：来自FDIC倒闭银行面板数据与硅谷银行—第一公民银行案例的实证证据
translated_abstract: 倒闭银行的收购方需要联合权衡收购价值、监管保护、风险、买方实力与执行难度，因为每个信号的含义都依赖于其他信号：例如当政府损失分担机制吸收损失时，高不良贷款的重要性便会降低。本文提出的蜘蛛网络过滤框架将这种依赖关系编码为五个维度之间的四条可解释交互规则，为逻辑回归模型生成图启发性特征，并形成“推进/谨慎/回避”的决策规则。我们在2008至2024年间由母公司在美国上市的收购方完成的55宗联邦存款保险公司（FDIC）协助的收购交易上对该框架进行评估。其中六个财务输入来自每次银行倒闭前发布的监管报告；两项交易条款（中标方在出价时已知悉，但投资者在公告时才获知）来自监管机构的新闻稿。结果——公告前后三天窗口内的正异常收益……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出蜘蛛网络过滤框架，将倒闭银行收购中五个维度信号间的相互依赖编码为四条可解释的交互规则，据此构建“推进/谨慎/回避”决策规则，并在2008—2024年55宗FDIC协助收购中以公告期正异常收益加以验证。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes the Spider Network Filtering Framework, which encodes interdependencies among five acquisition-signal dimensions as four interpretable interaction rules to drive a Pursue/Caution/Avoid decision rule, validated on 55 FDIC-assisted failed-bank acquisitions (2008–2024) using positive announcement-window abnormal returns.
